sources.entry: goccc by backstabslash - Fast, zero-dependency cost calculator and customizable statusline for Claude Code. Breakdowns by model, day, project, and branch. Lightweight, single binary, no runtime needed.

summary.one_liner: A zero-dependency Go command-line tool that calculates Claude Code usage costs from local session logs, with breakdowns by model, day, project and branch, plus a customizable statusline and tool analytics.
summary.what_it_does: goccc reads Claude Code's local JSONL session files (under ~/.claude by default) and totals token cost using its own pricing table. It prints all-time or windowed summaries and breakdowns by day, month, project, and model, with filters for project name and last N days, and supports JSON output for scripting. A statusline mode renders a live dashboard showing session cost, today's total, context usage, rate-limit window remaining (subscription users), and current model, configurable through ~/.goccc.json with segments, separators, and optional powerline styling. A SessionEnd hook mode prints a cost summary when a session ends. A -tools mode reports how often each tool, agent type, and skill was invoked, and flags unused skills. Currency can be set to a local code with an exchange rate cached for 24 hours, or overridden with flags.
use_cases: Track Claude Code spending by project or day
Show live cost and context usage in the terminal statusline
Get a cost summary when a Claude Code session ends
Analyze which tools, agents, and skills Claude Code uses
Export usage data as JSON for scripts or jq
Report costs in a local currency
notable: Zero dependencies and ships as a single binary with no runtime needed
Statusline is fully configurable via ~/.goccc.json, including powerline style and a kaomoji pet segment driven by Claude Code hooks
SessionEnd hook shows a per-session cost summary, designed to fail silently within Claude Code's 1.5-second hook timeout
Tool and skill analytics flag unused skills and filter by project or day
caveats: Rate-limit (5h/7d) statusline segments appear only for subscription users and are hidden for API billing
Claude Code deletes logs after 30 days by default; cleanupPeriodDays must be raised to keep longer history
Powerline style requires a Nerd Font and a truecolor terminal
Currency conversion fetches an exchange rate, and falls back to the last cached rate if the API is unreachable
